latestTerminalSummary:
**Verdict: REVISE.** The full statements stand. Theorem A for every `n ≥ 2` and every edge, and Corollary B for every `m ≥ 4` and every path of `n ≥ 1` edges, need no mathematical repair. The candidate is not accepted, and the campaign count is unchanged.

The audit is in `frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/kn-minus-edge-manuscript-review-r1/review.md` (20,041 bytes, SHA-256 `caf0e282fa79dce82acdd12f8e188f1ab9f736d5a9024e729829bf63900f3df8`). The manuscript directory was not edited.

Three required fixes:

- **R1, attribution.** The abstract, Section 1.1, README, metadata, and source map call Corollary B new exactly for odd `m ≥ 13`. At `n = 1` the Ouyang–Wang–Huang coefficient of `cr(K_{m+2}−e)` is zero, so the value is `2Z(m+1)` from Harary–Hill alone. The new bound is an input only for odd `m ≥ 13` and `n ≥ 2`. For `m = 13`, `n = 1` is `630`; `n = 2` is `1050`, and the counting ceiling `419` at order 15 would make that product `1049`. Keep the full corollary. State the Section 7 bounded-search limit on the product as well. The matching upper bound on that range is classical.
- **R2, coverage documentation.** Section 9 and `formal-scope.json` still say no lemma has a machine-checked proof. `KnMinusEdge.lean` has 47 theorems and 17 definitions (64 declarations), `Controls.lean` has 9, and the formal review (`bbb0344dda8194ef776a8c4bc68a8d44894e6cee178fe019a78cfd962f4d3773`) is `PASS_SCOPED_SUPPORT` with 16 independent controls. Drawing topology, both evaluation injections, the factor of 4, the even and upper arguments, and Corollary B remain paper-only. Do not call this a certificate of the crossing theorem. This audit did not recompile Lean.
- **R3, reproducibility.** `verify_package.py` passes on the handoff directory. On a clean unzip it raises `FileNotFoundError` for the zip, then for `output-manifest.json`, then for `SHA256SUMS`, instead of printing `VERIFY FAILED`. A public mode should check the extraction against `public-manifest.json`.

Pinned inputs match: `main.tex` `a70f6090…e0b6`, `main.pdf` `99437882…d921`, manuscript output manifest `2c8b828f…7254`. Release checks R1–R9 were rerun here in 69.6 seconds, exit 0, stdout identical to the frozen log. An independent algebra check also passes (`receipts/independent-algebra.out`). The 20-minute mod-`p` run was not repeated. `author-modp.out` is the 7-line subset for orders 15, 17, and 19 of the frozen 15-line log, not a byte-identical copy. All 15 PDF pages were read. No visual repair is required.

Optional only: the runtime stamp uses `time.monotonic` while the checker header says no floating point; the title page does not print “no affiliation”; the metadata date is 2026-10-16 and the reproducible PDF creation time is 15 October 2026.

`input-manifest.json` authenticates 84 inputs. `output-manifest.json` (4,405 bytes, SHA-256 `3298471988fcd7969840f3d11cb092b47b6fa61e3c5b9c752a5ed2b40f8f5b26`) and `SHA256SUMS` cover this review directory and were rechecked with no mismatches.
